test_title: PYST 22 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

He will not tell a lie.

options.text: A lie is not told by him.
A lie will not be told by him.
A lie was not told by him.
A lie will not have been told by him.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. A lie will not be told by him.
